symptom: Every workflow written to a Mendix 10.24 or 11.0 project made it unloadable (`mx check`/Studio Pro: `TypeCacheUnknownTypeException … Workflows$StartWorkflowActivity`); on 11.1 and 11.2 it loaded but failed `mx check` with CE6671 "An end activity can only be placed at the end of a path" and CE6689 "The 'Workflow end' cannot be reached". `mxcli check` and `exec` were clean throughout. Activities also carried `RelativeMiddlePoint`/`Size` below 11.1, `alter workflow … insert` included
cause: The executor always builds an explicit start + activities + end, and the encoder wrote them unconditionally. `StartWorkflowActivity` is introduced in 11.1.0 (mendixmodelsdk 4.117.0), but 11.1 and 11.2 still keep the main flow's start and end implicit — only 11.3 stores them (mx convert of a 10.24 workflow). The geometry keys are declared on the supertype `Workflows$WorkflowActivity` from 11.1.0, and `canon.StripUndeclaredProperties` looks up the concrete type's own declarations only, so supertype keys passed through; it cannot remove a whole element anyway
file: `mdl/backend/modelsdk/workflow_write.go` (`encodeWorkflow`: `withImplicitStartAndEnd` below 11.3, `withoutWorkflowActivityGeometry` below 11.1), `workflow_mutator_write.go` (inserted activity), `mdl/backend/wfmutator/mutator.go` (`setStartNote` falls back to the workflow's own Annotation when there is no start), `mdl/executor/validate_workflow_rewrite.go` (`rawMainFlowEnd`), `modelsdk/canon/studiopro_property_defaults.json` (10.24's `*OnStateChangeEvent`)
insight: **A type's introduction version and the version that starts storing it are different boundaries** — 11.1 knows `StartWorkflowActivity`, 11.3 writes it; only a conversion of an older model (mx convert) shows which shape a version stores, and the CE codes tell the two apart (load failure vs CE6671/CE6689). **Type-level introductions are not in the generated `version.go` table** (it records properties); read them from the Model SDK's `gen/<domain>.js`. **The property-set pass does not see supertype-declared keys**, so a key declared on an abstract base escapes it — gate those in the encoder. **A whole-file `-- @version: 11.0+` gate on the only workflow doctype script meant the nightly 10.24 leg never wrote one workflow**; a version-split script (`24b-…`, 10.0+) closes it. **Changing what is stored breaks every reader that assumed the old shape**: the rewrite guard counted branch Ends as "all stored Ends − 1", taking the main flow's closing End as always present — with it implicit, one branch End counted as none and `create or modify` dropped it silently (measured on 10.24 with the guard reverted: "Modified workflow"); grep the readers for the shape before changing a writer. **The first 10.0+ run found a third gap**: 10.24's `mx convert` adds `UsertaskOnStateChangeEvent`/`WorkflowOnStateChangeEvent` (`{"v":null}`, declared 9.12–11.0) to every workflow — folded in with `propdefaults` from a 10.24 + 11.0 record. Measured: bug-test on fresh 10.24.24/11.0.0/11.1.0/11.3.0 apps, fixed = blank-app baseline, both predicates stubbed true = the reported symptom per version. Test `workflow_version_shape_test.go`, example `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1754-workflow-below-mendix-11-3.mdl`
